scope: Full read of eight assigned frozen source files; family entries cover all declarations and exported flows.

entries.name: visit_dtype, codec_fail, inspect_node, require_children
entries.purpose: Resolve dtype and enforce stored-node contracts
entries.costs: Switch and backend inspection at operation boundary; child list and sort allocate

entries.name: base_shape, axes_for, selected_shape, element_count
entries.purpose: Resolve physical/selected extents and overflow
entries.costs: Shape and axis vectors copied/allocated; backend logical-shape inspection

entries.name: coordinate, physical_coordinate
entries.purpose: Translate flattened selected positions to source coordinates
entries.costs: Two rank-sized vector allocations per batch

entries.name: valid_utf8, validate_single_string
entries.purpose: Validate UTF-8 at read boundary
entries.costs: Byte scan; decoder duplicates two private implementations

entries.name: read_strings_all, read_string_array
entries.purpose: Read bounded runs into vector or packed owner
entries.costs: I/O per contiguous prefix; output owner grows with result; rank vectors per batch; duplicate traversal

entries.name: PackedColumnStrings, read_packed_column_strings
entries.purpose: Build final packed column storage with bounded staging
entries.costs: Two backend passes; offsets and final payload allocations; size stability check

entries.name: read_string_scalar, required_bool, optional_string
entries.purpose: Read scalar and encoding attributes
entries.costs: One bounded read or metadata lookup; string result copies

entries.name: child_node, element_encoding, table_index_key, table_index_node, table_axis, column_length
entries.purpose: Build retained selected nodes and resolve metadata
entries.costs: Shared-node allocation, axis copies, backend inspections

entries.name: read_column, read_table, read_element
entries.purpose: Materialize categorical, nullable, table and recursive metadata
entries.costs: Owns resulting data; per-field backend reads, possible plans, copies and validation; recursion

entries.name: BackedStringArray operations
entries.purpose: Shape, select, scalar read and full materialization
entries.costs: Shape/axis allocations and backend calls; explicit full owner copy for promoted color

entries.name: BackedColumn operations
entries.purpose: Access and select values, categories and codes
entries.costs: Category access may scan and construct spill plan; code/dictionary handles retain plan; full read materializes

entries.name: BackedTable operations
entries.purpose: Access index and columns, select and materialize
entries.costs: Per-call metadata inspection, name/column vector allocation; bounded scalar I/O

entries.name: BackedElement operations
entries.purpose: Decode kinds, mapping access, field access and materialization
entries.costs: Encoding inspection, child lists, shared nodes, full owner allocation for read

entries.name: StructureSource, StructureEditImpl, usable
entries.purpose: Own deferred edit sources and reject stale/consumed sessions
entries.costs: Map nodes, retained sources, revision checks

entries.name: path helpers, check_path, is_dataframe_column, put, change_for, is_erased
entries.purpose: Validate editable paths and nonoverlapping staged changes
entries.costs: Component/path strings and map iteration, metadata inspections

entries.name: Shape, array_shape, value_shape, source_shape, source_kind, validate_source
entries.purpose: Resolve owned/backed edit types, shapes, validation
entries.costs: Variant dispatch at edit boundary; shape vectors; validation scans

entries.name: stored_shape, final_shape, matrix_shape, pairwise_shape, aligned_shape
entries.purpose: Check original and final slot geometry
entries.costs: Metadata inspection and path component allocation

entries.name: names_with_changes, physical_present
entries.purpose: Merge stored and pending slot names
entries.costs: Set allocation and metadata calls

entries.name: Index and index_of/axis_index/compare_indexes
entries.purpose: Compare axis and aligned table indexes without full snapshots
entries.costs: Variant dispatch, bounded backed index cursors and backend reads

entries.name: check_aligned_table, validate_column_changes, nested_table, validate_parent
entries.purpose: Preflight alignment, columns and parent encodings
entries.costs: Metadata calls, sets, potential row-by-row name reads

entries.name: Preflight and preflight
entries.purpose: Validate final axis and slot state before mutation
entries.costs: Builds selected handles; scans paths and aligned metadata; no store writes

entries.name: Generated, reindex_actions
entries.purpose: Generate reindex and palette replacements with retained source handles
entries.costs: Vectors and per-key metadata; captures category/color dependencies

entries.name: coded, ensure_parent, source_node, unused_temporary, stage
entries.purpose: Create missing parents and stage owned/backed sources
entries.costs: Backend mutation and streaming copy; temporary store nodes

entries.name: preserve_matching_attributes, replace, erase_stored, apply_column
entries.purpose: Preserve metadata and apply individual structural mutations
entries.costs: Recursive backend inspection/copy, erase/rename, revision invalidation; not a store transaction

entries.name: StructureEdit and BackedAnnData mutation methods
entries.purpose: Expose edit lifecycle, preflight, staging, partial-failure reporting
entries.costs: Action vectors, endangered-source quadratic comparison, store I/O; caller must synchronize

entries.name: fail, with_validation_path, child_path, encoding, element_count, shape_of
entries.purpose: Error context, encoding and shape boundary helpers
entries.costs: Path and shape/attribute allocations; exception translation

entries.name: valid_utf8, validate_text, validate_key
entries.purpose: Validate serialized strings and path components
entries.costs: Byte scans; mandatory NUL/key checks, full-only payload UTF-8

entries.name: validate_unique_values, validate_unique_numeric
entries.purpose: Validate numeric category uniqueness and NaN
entries.costs: Hash-set allocation proportional to categories; possible noncontiguous full copy; dtype dispatch once

entries.name: validate_array, validate_column, validate_table, validate_element
entries.purpose: Validate serialization and recursive values
entries.costs: Scans and hash sets; path construction; repeated with writer entry points

entries.name: coordinates, write_array
entries.purpose: Write dense/sparse arrays with direct or packed paths
entries.costs: Contiguous direct write; fallback packs scratch or copies selected tile; sparse noncontiguous can copy whole owner

entries.name: write_strings, write_string_array
entries.purpose: Preflight and stage bounded string prefixes
entries.costs: Preflight full traversal; per-batch vector/string copies and backend writes; scalar path

entries.name: write_column, write_table
entries.purpose: Write categorical, nullable, numeric and table encodings
entries.costs: Dictionary validation may rescan/hash; mask scratch buffer; per-column backend operations

entries.name: write_null, write_element_impl, mapping writers
entries.purpose: Serialize recursive metadata and mappings
entries.costs: Kind/dtype dispatch at element boundary; per-child backend writes

entries.name: validate_axis_element, validate_dataset_impl and exported entry points
entries.purpose: Validate dataset alignment then initialize store
entries.costs: Multiple validation passes and metadata scans; writes not an atomic transaction

entries.name: fail, io_fail, seek_file, tell_file, TempRun, make_run, read_exact, write_exact, finish_run
entries.purpose: Own and manage external uniqueness runs
entries.costs: Temporary-file I/O and OS file-offset API; checked errors

entries.name: write_string, Head, load_head, copy_record, compare_records
entries.purpose: Compare and copy spilled string records with bounded buffers
entries.costs: File seeks and reads; fixed stack buffers

entries.name: MergeResult, merge_two, RunLevels, add_run, write_sorted_run, levels_unique
entries.purpose: Sort and merge external uniqueness runs
entries.costs: O(log runs) retained files; repeated temp I/O, sorting and head vector

entries.name: next_run_capacity, UniqueAccumulator
entries.purpose: Buffer strings under budget and spill sorted unique runs
entries.costs: Vector capacity/payload accounted; allocations, sorting and temp files

entries.name: reject_nonunique, numeric_key
entries.purpose: Cache uniqueness rejection and canonicalize numeric keys
entries.costs: Per-value string key allocation possible; NaN and signed-zero normalization

entries.name: require_unique_index, require_unique_categories
entries.purpose: Validate selected index/dictionary uniqueness
entries.costs: Bounded read batches and external runs; shared revision uniqueness state

entries.name: IndexCursor, compare_table_indexes overloads
entries.purpose: Compare indexes rowwise without full snapshots
entries.costs: Two bounded read caches, backend I/O, vector release/refill

entries.name: fail, attrs, shape_of, count_of, subnode, require_children
entries.purpose: Inspect and shape streamed data with contract checks
entries.costs: Paths, vectors and child sorting; retained node allocation

entries.name: validate_utf8, validate_utf8_string
entries.purpose: Validate streamed UTF-8 payloads
entries.costs: Byte scan, duplicates codec/writer decoders

entries.name: copy_strings
entries.purpose: Stream selected string values to destination
entries.costs: Bounded prefix staging and output I/O, per-run axis lookups

entries.name: signed_value, category_code, validate_codes
entries.purpose: Validate categorical code ranges during copy
entries.costs: Bounded byte buffer; per-code dtype switch

entries.name: check_table, check_aligned_shape, compare_table_index, check_dataset, check_export_metadata
entries.purpose: Preflight schema, alignment and export attributes
entries.costs: Set/vector allocations, backend metadata traversal and bounded index comparison

entries.name: BorrowedBackend, validation_view, Sink
entries.purpose: Provide validation-local read adapter and write sink
entries.costs: Virtual forwarding and retained session; record methods omitted

entries.name: validate_category_dictionary
entries.purpose: Check dictionary encoding, missingness and uniqueness
entries.costs: Backend reads and bounded external uniqueness; mode-dependent scans

entries.name: copy_node_impl, copy_node, export_store, validate_all
entries.purpose: Dispatch streamed copy, full-store export and validation
entries.costs: Per-node virtual backend calls, recursion, bounded transfer; adapters omit record operations

entries.name: fail, io_fail, TempFile, read_exact, write_exact
entries.purpose: Own temporary category file and robust positional I/O
entries.costs: POSIX calls and temporary files; retry on EINTR, range checks

entries.name: Bitset
entries.purpose: Mark categories with memory or paged temporary bitmap
entries.costs: Bounded memory/page, disk I/O and dirty flush; no internal synchronization

entries.name: visit_integer, decode_code, encode_code, CodeSource, code_source, scan_codes
entries.purpose: Acquire typed categorical codes and scan selected runs
entries.costs: Switch outside loop, bounded byte buffer and backend calls

entries.name: CategoryPlan, scratch_remaining
entries.purpose: Retain selected positions, optional page and composed plans; charge scratch
entries.costs: Shared pointers and recursive capacity accounting; file-backed mutable page

entries.name: category_count, category_source_count, category_position, category_recode, compose_category_plans
entries.purpose: Resolve selected category positions and recoding
entries.costs: Binary searches and possible file page reads; mutable shared cache; failed refill publishes marker

entries.name: recode_codes_buffer, make_category_plan
entries.purpose: Recode typed values and build selected dictionary plan
entries.costs: Selected-code scan; vector sort or spill bitmap and positional-file I/O

entries.name: copy_recoded_codes, copy_pruned_category
entries.purpose: Stream selected codes and dictionary in bounded budget
entries.costs: Typed recoding and bounded transfer; backend I/O; retains category plans

entries.name: fail, Resolution, category_path, resolve
entries.purpose: Resolve selected categorical palette and promotion over slice history
entries.costs: Backend inspections, per-stage category plans, shared nodes and potential spill; budget partition

entries.name: scalar_string, scalar_array, numeric_scalar_array, encoding_attrs
entries.purpose: Read/promote scalar color with dtype dispatch
entries.costs: Result allocation, backend reads and fill; dtype switch once

entries.name: color_keys, color_child, color_changed_keys, color_has_changes
entries.purpose: Filter selected color names and identify changed palettes
entries.costs: Child list and metadata inspections; repeated resolution and plan creation

entries.name: read_color_override, copy_promoted_color
entries.purpose: Materialize or stream promoted palette
entries.costs: Full returned owner vs bounded copied batches; byte/string buffers and backend operations

entries.name: fail, count, shape_of, run_at, source_run, field_info, make_array, field_path
entries.purpose: Validate record shape and map selected runs/field types
entries.costs: Shape vectors, dtype switch and backend run boundaries; checked address range

entries.name: read_record_value, read_record_field, read_record
entries.purpose: Read selected numeric and string record fields
entries.costs: Final owners plus bounded string prefixes; backend calls per selected run

entries.name: write_record
entries.purpose: Write record fields from dense strided and text views
entries.costs: Field schema allocation, reusable numeric packing, string batches; backend record calls

entries.name: copy_record
entries.purpose: Stream selected record fields to destination
entries.costs: Bounded packing and string staging; backend record calls; validation adapters must support record methods
